name: thinkrail
description: Vibe code with pi in a lightweight, real IDE that customises itself around the way you work — The Vibe You Need
one_liner: A code editor built around an AI agent, where each task gets its own isolated workspace, the agent keeps notes on the project that survive between sessions, and you review and ship the result through built-in GitHub tools.
buyer: An engineering manager at a small software team who wants multiple AI coding tasks running in parallel without engineers stepping on each other's work.
business_use_cases: A small dev team runs several AI agent tasks at once in isolated git-worktree workspaces, merging the good ones and discarding the rest, cutting the time a human spends babysitting one task at a time.
A technical founder uses the living SPEC.md files so the AI agent (and any new hire) can get up to speed on project intent without a long onboarding conversation every time.
An agency juggling several client codebases keeps each client's workspace and PR flow separate inside one tool instead of switching IDEs.

money_ideas.idea: None directly — it's a free JetBrains tool, not something to resell as-is.
Sell 'parallel AI development' setup and process consulting to teams adopting it, since the isolated-workspace workflow is new to most teams.

steal_this: It's a free JetBrains incubator tool with no business model attached for outsiders to resell — the realistic weekend move is just adopting it to run two or three AI coding tasks in parallel on your own backlog and comparing throughput to your current single-threaded workflow.
